# Mathew Loulas — mindfax.art

> Author writing under the pen name **The Architect**, and AI systems architect.
> Creator of The Architect Universe and founder of MINDFAX OPS.
> Editorial thesis across the whole catalogue: human intelligence in the age of AI.

The person: Mathew Loulas (registered as Mateus Lolas in Brazilian public and academic
records). Writes as The Architect. Career public servant in Brazil, educator and executive
coordinator of PESES at the University of Brasilia since 2009. Founder of MINDFAX OPS.
Canonical page: https://mindfax.art/mathewloulas/
Canonical schema.org identifier: https://mindfax.art/#mathewloulas

## Structure of the work
One axis, one doctrine, three arms.
- The axis — The Architect Universe: https://mindfax.art/thearchitectuniverse/
- The doctrine — The Freedom Protocol, Volume Zero: https://mindfax.art/thefreedomprotocol/
- The cosmos arm — Mindfax: https://mindfax.art/mindfax/
- The mind arm — Neurabyte: https://mindfax.art/neurabyte/
- The matter arm — Finsage: https://mindfax.art/finsage-universe/

## Method
Specialised AI systems act as collaborators for research, development, review and
production. Authorship, judgment and final responsibility remain human. Anything
irreversible requires human approval.
